exposure: Overrepresented Ruminococcaceae, Christensenellaceae, Eubacterium, Treponema, Senegalimassilia, Ruminiclostridium, Roseburia, Romboutsia, Prevotella, and Veillonella seminalis
outcome: Behavioral outcomes at six-months of age (Denver Developmental Screening Test II - DDST-II)
cohort: The participants were infants from the Rio birth cohort whose meconium samples were surveyed and behavioral outcomes assessed at six-months of age.
finding: This pilot study found significant associations between the meconium microbiome (beta diversity, alpha diversity, and specific bacterial taxa) and the personal-social domain of neurobehavioral development at six months of age.
